source.notes: HOLD: do not publish until the owner sends a screenshot of the shop's ratings page (the listing shows a 51.6% store return rate; may be a mistranslated repeat-buyer rate, unconfirmed). Supplier: Yiwu Lisong Trading Co., Ltd. (same shop as the men's octagon set), 3 yrs on 1688. Title: 'Luxury women's quartz watch five-piece set: fashionable diamond-studded watch, necklace, earrings, and ring gift box set'; 'luxury' and 'diamond-studded' left out (stones not stated to be diamonds). Price range CNY 7.5 (about N1,675) to CNY 14 (about N3,126.66) from 1 item. Owner chose the with-box option: unit_cost 14, 150 g, price 9500 (2 Nov 2026); the owner did NOT confirm on the 1688 page that CNY 14 is the box price, so the cost and the box claim in the copy are unconfirmed. fx_rate 223.33 = 3126.66 / 14, the app's own conversion. Weights (1688 table): 50 g without gift box, 150 g with a black or white five-piece box; only the Sky blue and Blue rows are shown, other colours assumed the same. Attributes: quartz movement, waterproof 'Not allowed' (so not waterproof), brand = supplier's own mark, unused. Dials print 'Geneva' (script) and on some 'PLATINUM': owner chose to list under a generic name; cannot be cropped, not retouched, kept out of name, copy and tags; the pink watch-only close-up reading 'Geneva PLATINUM' is not used. Photos: watermark cropped; 800-970 px originals extended to 4:5, so soft at full size; they show the gift box. Ring, bracelet, earring and necklace sizes not stated; none claimed. Style names are ours. Price raised from NGN 9500 to NGN 10500 on 13 Nov 2026 (owner: every price carries its freight and card fee and keeps 45%; weight-based freight estimate).
